leadText: Volume 5: Going Coconuts is the fifth of ten volumes of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga created by Yumi Tsukirino.
plainText:
Volume 5: Going Coconuts is the fifth of ten volumes of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga created by Yumi Tsukirino.

==Blurb==
IN THIS VOLUME…

 and get stuck babysitting a bratty ; Coconut hypnotizes Almond to find his true love; Hazel goes on a quest for a foolproof love charm; learns a valuable lesson at a sadistic fat farm; our Pokémon and human friends celebrate Christmas; plus many more stories starring all your most favorite characters!

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Odd Oddish Out
The Terror of... the First Date!
Hypnotism
Wal of Power
Never Say Diet!
Hazel's Holiday
The Master Plan... for Romance!
Magikarp Journey
